onset.Description: Software observation time in seconds relative to PsyGodot session origin, not physical display/audio onset.

duration.Description: Zero marks a discrete observation or transition; it is not a note, song or pause interval duration.

source_event_id.Description: Original event ID within the paired raw session.

event_kind.Description: Offline event classification; judgments describe controller processing, not visual or auditory presentation.

input_source.Description: Origin of the triggering input or game update.

Levels.replay: Recorded or scripted input path; not a participant response at this observation time.

input_index.Description: Input sequence within this song. Zero marks autonomous processing; positive values link responses and outcomes.

response_lane.Description: Game lane or long-note kind, not physical hand or keyboard key.

song_time.Description: Game-computed song time used by processing; distinct from the monotonic observation time.

scheduled_time.Description: Planned note time from the chart, not observed stimulus onset.

observed_timestamp_usec.Description: Godot monotonic song-start observation before the recorder session was initialized; retained verbatim.

note_id.Description: Note identity within the song, linking judgments and long-note updates.

judgment.Description: Game timing judgment retained verbatim; does not infer scientific correctness.

timing_error.Description: Signed game-computed input minus planned note time, converted from milliseconds; not reaction time or device latency.

score.Description: Game score at the recorded controller operation.

combo.Description: Game combo at the recorded controller operation.

reason.Description: Game-reported reason for termination or note expiry.

hit_count.Description: Registered cumulative hits on this roll or balloon note.

balloon_cleared.Description: Whether the balloon hit requirement was reached.

marker_code.Description: Assigned catalog marker code; not evidence of transmission or EEG receipt.
